description: Inspect one immutable LMS course version: its frozen tree is the complete content inventory (every ASSESSMENT lesson pins formId/formVersionId/formVersionNumber/formContentHash; every lesson lists its private assetIds), plus contentHash, attribution (author of the published draft revision and publisher), ordered modules, canonical mastery eligibility reasons, and authorized human-navigation URLs. Requires lms:read.
name: opentrain_lms_get_course_version
